_note: Heading and intro are VERBATIM from punarjiva.in. The form itself is new — the live site has no form, only Call and WhatsApp. Those two CTAs are kept prominent here; the form is an addition, not a replacement.
_backgroundNote: Header background photograph. Swap for a real store photo by putting a file in assets/images/ and using a project-relative path like 'assets/images/storeFront.jpg'. backgroundTint controls readability over it: 'strong' (most legible), '' (default), or 'light' (photo shows through most). Remove backgroundImage entirely to fall back to the plain brand gradient.
pageIntro: Share your grocery, cosmetic or wellness list; we'll confirm availability and guide you with care.
quickText: Most orders are placed on WhatsApp — send your list and we reply with what is in stock.
formIntro: Fill this in and we will get back to you. Prefer instant? Use WhatsApp or call the store directly.

fields.emailHint: Optional — we will reply on WhatsApp if you leave this blank.
fields.messagePlaceholder: Type your grocery, cosmetic or wellness list here…

validation.phoneRequired: Please enter a phone number we can reach you on.
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
validation.emailInvalid: That email address does not look right.
validation.messageRequired: Please tell us what you are looking for.

successText: We will get back to you shortly. For anything urgent, please call the store.
errorText: The form could not reach our server. Please call or WhatsApp us instead — we will respond right away.
endpointNotice: Setup note for the site owner: this form posts to the placeholder endpoint in config/apiEndpoints.json and will fail until a real URL is set there. Nothing else needs changing.
